categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the new energy sector, focusing on investment in new energy power stations, EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) projects for new energy, equipment sales for new energy power stations, and power station operation and maintenance services. It also engages in manufacturing and sales of photovoltaic equipment and related technical services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes technologies related to photovoltaic power generation, wind power projects, and EPC engineering methods. It employs production and manufacturing techniques for photovoltaic equipment, including single crystal silicon growth furnaces, cutting machines, and related components. The company also applies project management and construction technologies in power station development and operation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large state-owned enterprises and engineering companies such as Shanghai Electric Power Construction Co., Ltd. and China Power Construction Group. The company serves the renewable energy industry, particularly solar and wind power sectors, with projects mainly in China’s Northeast, North China, and East China regions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with significant business in the Northeast, North China, East China, and other regional markets. It has subsidiaries and projects across multiple provinces including Jiangsu, Shanxi, Liaoning, Inner Mongolia, and Beijing.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the renewable energy supply chain, including EPC contracting, equipment manufacturing and sales, and operation and maintenance of power stations. It also invests in power station assets, indicating involvement in asset management within the value chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The strategic focus is on accelerating project execution, enhancing cooperation with national and central enterprises in the new energy sector, and developing profitable high-quality projects. The company emphasizes improving operational management, reducing costs, and expanding its renewable energy power station development and asset management businesses. R&D efforts are aligned with photovoltaic and wind power technologies and EPC project innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through EPC project contracts, sales of new energy power station equipment, and operation and maintenance service fees. The company recognizes revenue based on contract progress and service delivery, with a focus on project-based income and equipment sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with leading domestic renewable energy EPC contractors and equipment manufacturers. It positions itself as a specialized provider of integrated new energy solutions including EPC, equipment sales, and power station operation services, leveraging its project execution capabilities and regional presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 161 million, a 56% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 27.3 million. The company’s net assets turned negative, indicating financial distress and risk of delisting. It has experienced significant declines in profitability and cash flow, reflecting challenges in sustaining growth and operational stability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its integrated capabilities in new energy power station development, EPC engineering, equipment manufacturing, and operation and maintenance services. It highlights its ability to deliver projects that achieve power generation targets exceeding expectations, thereby creating excess returns for clients. The company also focuses on cost control, project execution efficiency, and strategic partnerships with national energy enterprises to enhance competitiveness.
